consumers.evidence: Current product authority records the tray-owned service lifecycle, browser-hosted Redline console, unchanged phone PWA, and implementation-candidate boundary. Live replacement, browser, responsive, background-service, tray-readback, and device-file-retention checks passed; user-visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone rescan, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine acceptance remain pending.
DESKTOP-TRAY-WEB-CONSOLE-001 remains user_confirmed with deferred automatic download, WebView2, and full native UI scope.

Command scripts are wake or emergency entry points; the tray is the service-lifecycle Owner. Predecessor port-only stop is replaced by proven identity. Current sources no longer claim the tray is unimplemented.
Web console, runtime identity APIs, session rename/batch, tray Owner, packaging, and verification consumers are implemented in this branch as a candidate, not as delivery_integrated.
The chain is launcher to single tray Owner to identified Node service to browser console, with phone PWA and persistent LOCALAPPDATA device data kept separate.

STA NotifyIcon tray, occupant classification, loopback runtime/shutdown APIs, five-area Redline console, portable-package identity, and a main-thread tray IPC command queue are present in source; human NotifyIcon visibility is not claimed.
The implementation uses Windows PowerShell STA and WinForms already present on target Windows plus the bundled Node runtime; Electron, WebView2, online update, and new external runtimes are excluded.
Tray owns service lifecycle; runtime/tray receipts and process proof gate replacement; Unknown/Unproven occupants are fail-closed; trusted-device ownership and LOCALAPPDATA location are unchanged.
Version/build identity comes from packaged metadata; runtime records live in LOCALAPPDATA; install .env is overlay-only and excluded from the zip; Redline tokens are copied into project-owned CSS.

Automated identity, repeated-scan identity reuse with a top-level QR navigation cookie, device editing, BOM-free shared JSON, routing, style-scope, build, package-manifest, isolated package-smoke, and Headless tray IPC checks are recorded. Live two-directory replacement, browser five-area navigation, QR, 390px, mobile password entry, background-service, tray readback, same-version wake, password, and device-hash retention checks passed. User-visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone rescan, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine acceptance remain for the human controller.

The next authorized work is human confirmation of the visible NotifyIcon/menu, real-phone repeated scan, unknown-occupant manual comparison, and target-machine portable unzip. Automatic download, WebView2, full native UI, public internet, release, and delivery_integrated remain deferred.
Implementation candidate is on branch codex/desktop-tray-redline in E:/work/project/codexPWA using Cursor CLI, without a Task Control shell, force push, PR, or release.
